diagnosis.issue: Implementation uses a near-black/dark PDP treatment while the approved mockup is predominantly white/light with navy typography and gold accents.
diagnosis.correction: Remove the page-wide dark reinterpretation. Match the approved mockup's white/light content surfaces, navy typography, subtle light-gray rules/panels, gold accents, and dark styling only where explicitly shown such as CTA/footer imagery.

diagnosis.issue: Hero and thumbnails show unrelated scenic placeholder photography rather than wheel/product imagery represented by the approved mockup and product data.
diagnosis.correction: Do not introduce generic/scenic placeholders. Render the actual Shopify product media dynamically. If source product media is unavailable, preserve the product media slot without inventing unrelated imagery. The hero must visually read as a wheel PDP.

diagnosis.issue: Desktop composition, scale, spacing and hierarchy substantially differ from the approved mockup.
diagnosis.correction: Reconstruct the top PDP as the approved light two-column composition: large gallery left and product/configuration panel right, with comparable relative widths, density and vertical alignment. Use the approved 1178px Calder container baseline.

diagnosis.issue: Product controls are visually compressed and reorganized compared with the approved configuration card.
diagnosis.correction: Match the approved hierarchy: title/construction/subtitle/description, review+SKU row, fitment-confirmed box, Diameter+Width row, Finish with swatches, Vehicle Fitment/Application, Quantity+price, full-width gold Add to Cart, Save/Share, trust row.

diagnosis.issue: Existing configurator functionality was retained but visually presented as a large separate dark section that dominates the page and does not integrate with the approved design.
diagnosis.correction: Preserve every existing configurator binding and action, but visually migrate it into the approved light product system. The approved Choose Your Finish section is the primary visual model. Multi-part Center/Barrel/Hardware choices may remain, but must be integrated as a refined Calder configurator rather than retaining the old/reference-page visual structure.

diagnosis.issue: Full Fitment Finder remains a large standalone dark band rather than being visually integrated with the approved product flow.
diagnosis.correction: Preserve fitment logic. Use the approved compact Fits Your Vehicle state in the hero. Full selector should appear as the change/unselected workflow, styled in the approved light Calder system and not dominate the normal confirmed state.

diagnosis.issue: Specs and engineering treatment is structurally and visually different from the approved table + image-led Engineered to Perform panel.
diagnosis.correction: Match the approved section: left light specifications table; right large manufacturing image/background panel with heading, supporting copy and four capability icons. Keep data dynamic/configurable.

diagnosis.issue: Approved Available Finishes / Choose Your Finish wheel carousel is not represented with comparable fidelity.
diagnosis.correction: Implement the approved horizontal wheel-finish showcase using actual configurable/product finish media where available, selected gold outline, labels, and carousel behavior. Bind to existing configurator state where applicable.

diagnosis.issue: Gallery is rendered as empty dark placeholders.
diagnosis.correction: Use configured Shopify section images/product lifestyle media. Match the approved four-wide landscape image treatment and heading/subheading/View Gallery hierarchy. Do not ship empty dark boxes as the intended design.

diagnosis.issue: Recommendation cards do not visually match the approved B1 Calder product card and use unrelated placeholder photography.
diagnosis.correction: Reuse the actual approved shared B1 component and dynamic recommended wheel products/media. Match the approved white card treatment shown on the product mockup.

diagnosis.issue: Specialist CTA is a minimal centered block and approved branded CTA/footer composition is absent from the render.
diagnosis.correction: Reuse the established homepage Calder specialist CTA/footer pattern: dark navy image-led band, left-aligned heading/copy, gold Get in Touch action and contact methods, followed by approved global footer.

diagnosis.issue: Tablet render behaves like an extremely narrow/mobile layout rather than a deliberate tablet adaptation; mobile typography and content density are also excessively compressed.
diagnosis.correction: Implement explicit desktop/tablet/mobile responsive rules. 768px must read as tablet, not a 241px squeezed desktop capture. At 390px use single-column hierarchy with full usable viewport width, readable typography and horizontal carousels where appropriate.

diagnosis.issue: The 'native Lumia foundation + CSS restyle' decision constrained fidelity and allowed Lumia structure/visual assumptions to override the approved mockup.
diagnosis.correction: Native functionality may be reused, but native markup is not authoritative. Refactor/wrap/reorder markup or introduce Calder-specific presentation sections/snippets when required for fidelity, while preserving underlying Shopify/configurator/fitment behavior.

non_negotiables: Do not change the approved mockup into a dark theme.
Do not use unrelated scenic/stock placeholder images for product wheels or recommendation products.
Do not delete or rewrite working Build Your Wheel business logic.
Do not delete or rewrite working Fitment business logic.
Do not let native Lumia markup prevent matching the approved Calder mockup.
Do not duplicate configurator or fitment engines.
Use the approved homepage header/footer and approved B1 product card.
exit_criteria: Desktop immediately reads as the same design system/composition as the approved product mockup.
Light/white PDP color system matches reference.
Actual wheel/product media replaces unrelated scenic placeholders.
Hero configuration hierarchy closely matches approved mockup.
Build Your Wheel and Fitment remain functional but are visually integrated.
Specifications/engineering, finish showcase, real-world gallery, recommendations, specialist CTA and footer match approved hierarchy.
Tablet and mobile are intentional responsive adaptations.
No new Theme Check errors and functional smoke tests pass.
